verdict.line: You win nearly every trade and all-in before level 6; after K'Sante hits R (All Out) and finishes his tank items, extended fights start favoring him.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's kit is built around setup: Q (Ntofo Strikes) needs two stacks before it pulls, and W (Path Maker) needs a full charge before it stuns and knocks back. Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) silence punishes both windows by cutting off his only shield/dash (E, Footwork) or stun (W) when they're on cooldown. Before level 6 K'Sante has no comeback tool if you catch him clean; after he gets R (All Out) and a defensive item core, he starts winning the same all-in.

theirWindow.what: He can knock you back through terrain and dash in transformed with more damage and healing, at the cost of his own reduced defenses — don't stand near a wall he can punt you into, and if you can burst him during the transform before the healing ramps, do it immediately.

yourWindow.when: his W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) are both down
yourWindow.what: All-in with Q (Decisive Strike) to silence him, then E (Judgment) for sustained AoE damage — he has no shield, no dash, and no stun to answer with.

start.why: Blocks his auto-attack poke and Q slow-trades, keeps Perseverance ticking between fights.

boots.why: Reduces damage from his auto-heavy trading pattern and Q pokes; swap to Mercury's Treads if his CC chain (Q pull into W stun) becomes unmanageable.

core.why: Move speed and burst to stick through his dashes and close the gap after a silence.
On-hit healing and burst damage for the all-in window before his items come online.
Survivability and tenacity for the extended fights he starts winning post-6.

situational.when: he starts landing all-outs and the healing from R is keeping him alive
he builds into an on-hit or crit-heavy physical damage set
the game goes long and he's the primary threat diving your backline

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended trades and sustained fighting Garen wants once the silence lands.

summoners.why: Flash covers his knockback-stun engage from W or R; Teleport resets wave state and lets you punish his cooldown windows without giving up lane priority.

playing.title: Track his Q stacks
playing.detail: At 2 stacks he fires a shockwave that pulls you in — don't stand in Q range once he's at 1 stack.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Force fights while he has no R; your Q silence into E spin wins clean before All Out exists.

playing.title: Save Q for empty cooldowns
playing.detail: Hold Decisive Strike until his W or E is down so the silence removes his only escape or stun, not just an early poke.

playing.title: Respect walls post-6
playing.detail: Once he has All Out, avoid fighting near terrain he can knock you through to isolate you from allies.

playing.title: Punish the R defense drop
playing.detail: All Out reduces his own defenses while active — burst him in this window rather than trading slowly.

playing.title: Use W passive in extended fights
playing.detail: Courage's duration damage adds up over a long trade even if he's shielding hits with Footwork.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal once R sustain matters
playing.detail: His R grants healing when transformed — get Executioner's Calling components if he's surviving fights he should lose.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names shift patch to patch; this is the standard bruiser Garen build and Precision/Resolve page as of early-2026 knowledge — confirm current names in-client before locking in.
